title: Nissan USA newsroom: 2019 LEAF press kit
notes: 2019 LEAF / LEAF PLUS US press kit: 40 kWh (192 cells) and 62 kWh (288 cells) laminated Li-ion; PLUS has a "standard new 100kW capacity quick charging system"; 6.6 kW onboard charger (6.0 out) on both; Quick Charge Port on both; 80 % in 40 min (40 kWh) / 45 min (62 kWh); cabin remote pre-conditioning only, nothing on battery preconditioning.
